evidence.text:
– a new and emerging area of programming for children – with the goal to expand 
programming from the current 4 countries to an additional 20 countries.
$10 million funds the expansion, professionalization and sustainable financing 
of 16,000 social service workers for child protection in 12 countries – including in 
humanitarian contexts – to prevent and respond to child protection violations.
$10 million funds UNICEF’s work with national governments to advance adolescent 
girls’ education in 14 countries, to increase the proportion of girls enrolling, attending 
and completing secondary school with improved learning and life outcomes.
